note: 3 Mode B subagents (own writable worktrees, full constitution) returned 9 findings collapsing to 5 distinct themes. Each theme was re-reproduced by the orchestrator in /home/wds/vise-adv and run through the full catcher suite. All reproduced as claimed (every check green). Nothing discounted.

themes.title: core/ reads the wall clock (new Date()) — impure, non-deterministic domain rule
themes.gap: NEW axis beyond framework-freeness: purity/determinism. The code's own invariant ('a clock is never read here; today/now is passed IN') is unenforced. No rule forbids new Date()/Date.now()/Math.random() in slices/*/core. Import-based linters cannot see ambient effects.
themes.detector: an ESLint/oxlint no-restricted-syntax rule banning Date/Math.random/performance in core/** would catch the clock/random case (fixable); general eff- purity is semantic.

themes.title: domain logic/vocabulary smuggled into shared/lib under a generic, domain-noun-free name
themes.gap: The 'no domain noun under shared/' grep inspects filenames + exported identifiers only, never string-literal unions/arrays. lifecycleRank(['draft','issued','paid','void']), tax/total math, STATUS_LABELS for both slices all pass. Same root cause as Mode A6 but in shared/lib (functions).

themes.title: a shared/ui StatusPill hard-coding BOTH slices' status semantics (rule-6 two-costumes)
themes.gap: rule 6 (concern = reason to change) is not machine-checkable; a shared component that changes for two domains' reasons passes every structural check.

themes.title: over-broad public index re-exports the raw core entity + unfiltered query, bypassing the read model
themes.gap: GAP. slice-isolation + allow-list only verify a cross-slice edge TERMINATES at the target's index.ts file; they never constrain WHAT index.ts exposes. Re-exporting Appointment (core entity) and fetchAppointments (unfiltered) makes billing depend on scheduling's internal shape while every check stays green. The 'tiny public surface' (rule 3) is a convention, not enforced.

themes.title: unvalidated snake_case server shape declared inline in queries.ts escapes data/ into the UI
themes.gap: GAP. dtos-stay-home equates 'DTO' with 'a type imported from data/dto.ts'. A server-shaped interface (invoice_id/download_url/expires_at) declared in data/queries.ts and returned unmapped (no zod, no mapper) is imported by ui/ freely — ui->data is a legal intra-slice edge and the type did not come from dto.ts. Catching 'any unvalidated server shape' is largely semantic.
